clue.text: Mortal sins we'd do revealing weaknesses

indicators.note: a mortal blow wrecks what it strikes, so these letters are smashed and rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: the nine letters of these three words are the raw material for rearrangement

explanation.surface: Confessing the deadly sins one commits lays bare a person's moral failings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mortal sins' reads as a fixed theological phrase, but 'Mortal' is detached to work on the letters of the next three words.
explanation.definitionFit: Downsides are drawbacks or flaws, the same as weaknesses in a plan or person.

clue.text: Talk about disposing of US records

indicators.note: getting rid of something removes it, so the named letters leave the longer word

parts.note: to talk about a topic is to discuss it
taken as written

explanation.surface: A conversation about getting rid of American recordings.
explanation.definitionFit: Discs are gramophone records, the old physical format for music.

clue.text: Bird got around ridges after striking wings out

parts.note: to have got a prize is to have won it

indicators.note: the wings of a word are its outer letters; striking them out leaves only the inner part

parts.note: the word ridges with its two end letters gone

explanation.surface: A bird circling over mountain ridges after clipping its wings.
explanation.definitionFit: The widgeon is a species of dabbling duck, so it is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Rebel set up snares when interrupted by copper

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: traps are snares

indicators.note: the word for when is broken apart by the metal's symbol going inside it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as the sun rose'
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: An insurgent lays traps for pursuers but is caught by a policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a police officer, which suits the rebel story, but here it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartacus was the gladiator who led the great slave revolt against Rome, the archetypal rebel.

clue.text: Overbearing monk in middle of meek group

parts.note: Dom is the title given to a Benedictine monk
taken as written

indicators.note: the central letters of the word meek, its ends dropped

parts.note: the two inner letters of meek
a ring is a group, as of spies or thieves

explanation.surface: A domineering monk among a meek gathering of brothers.
explanation.definitionFit: Domineering means bossy and controlling, the same as overbearing in manner.

clue.text: Give idle talk up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is written upwards, so reversed

parts.note: gas is chatter or idle talk

explanation.walkthrough: 'Give up' reads as a phrasal verb, but the two words are split: 'Give' defines, 'up' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: To sag is to droop or yield under weight, as a beam or rope gives.

clue.text: Assess reservoir in which uranium's found

the element is found inside the reservoir word

U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.definitionFit: To sum up is to evaluate or form a judgement of something, as one assesses a situation.

clue.text: Author about to pen good letter in Greek

turned about, so the author's name is reversed

parts.note: Kingsley or Martin Amis, the English novelists

explanation.walkthrough: 'about to pen' looks like 'on the point of writing'; 'about' reverses and 'to pen' encloses.

clue.text: Thought about sun-god with a female name

Ra is the Egyptian sun-god
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Miranda is a girl's name, made famous by the heroine of Shakespeare's The Tempest.

clue.text: Willy between legs showing small piercings

prick is vulgar slang for willy, a penis

explanation.walkthrough: In British English a willy is a penis; the surface's double entendre is deliberate.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinpricks are tiny punctures, the sort of small hole a needle point makes.

clue.text: Weapon is turned against beloved maiden

indicators.note: turned round, so the two letters are reversed

parts.note: taken as written before turning
dear means beloved
M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A weapon is aimed against a beloved young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a handgun or sword carried at the side, a personal weapon.

clue.text: Long-distance traveller's smile welcoming Turkish chief

indicators.note: the smile takes in the chief, holding his title inside it

parts.note: a grin is a broad smile
an aga is an Ottoman commander or chief

explanation.walkthrough: Read the 's as 'is': the traveller is the grin welcoming the aga.
explanation.definitionFit: Yuri Gagarin was the first human in space, the ultimate long-distance voyager of 1961.

clue.text: Sensed odour of fish

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the past tense of smell
second meaning: a small silvery food fish

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as smelling fish; the two parts are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a British past tense of the verb to smell and the name of a small sea and freshwater fish.

clue.text: Figure outside uncovered venomous snakes and runs — that's obvious!

parts.note: cobras are venomous snakes

clue.text: Sea water's hiding Godzilla, primarily hostile to ships

parts.note: the opening letter of the monster's name
anti means against, hostile to

explanation.definitionFit: Brigantines are two-masted sailing vessels, a type of ship.

clue.text: Not supportive of Tory

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as opposing a Conservative; the two parts are separate meanings of one short word. A Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a preposition meaning against and an abbreviation for a Conservative politician.

clue.text: Sauce is element paired with a shelled crab

parts.note: carbon is a chemical element
taken as written

indicators.note: with its shell removed, the word loses its outer letters

parts.note: the word crab without its outer letters

explanation.surface: A sauce made by pairing a chemical element with crab meat out of the shell.

clue.text: Wine portion from kitchen in blancmange

explanation.definitionFit: Chenin blanc is a white grape variety and the wine made from it, grown widely in the Loire.

clue.text: Resistance to split bill including small with big meal

clue.text: Bring round adaptable crate and use it to store spades

parts.note: taken as written, as letters to rearrange
taken as written, as letters to rearrange
S is the bridge abbreviation for spades

clue.text: Staff having misplaced respect

indicators.note: letters put in the wrong place are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Employees who have lost the respect they once had.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' suggests workers; here it is a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A sceptre is an ornamental rod carried by a monarch, a ceremonial staff.

clue.text: This equine caught in brier would get louder

the pictured donkey would bray more; cryptically, the word brier with the animal inside becomes brassier, meaning louder

explanation.walkthrough: The clue works in reverse: put the answer inside the word brier and you get a word for louder. Remove brier's letters from that word to see it.
explanation.definitionFit: An ass is a donkey, a member of the horse family.

clue.text: Contents inside dark cabin, pans from Middle East

indicators.note: the contents of each word are its inner letters, the ends removed

parts.note: the inner letters of dark
the inner letters of cabin
the inner letters of pans

explanation.surface: The things inside a dim cabin include pans from the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabian describes something of Arabia, the peninsula at the heart of the Middle East.

clue.text: Error during hours of darkness, taking south for north

parts.note: overnight means through the night

clue.text: Consume power within broadcast

parts.note: to send a signal is to broadcast it

clue.text: Arboreal creature ruined western half of Oklahoma area

clue.text: 'Fish learn': upcoming article
